title: Great Pyramid chambers aligned to Sirius and Orion in 10,500 BC

tellings.quote: called The King and queen's chamber that face different constellations right the Queen's chamber faces Sirius

related.note: Both say which star targets the Great Pyramid's chamber shafts point at. This telling puts Sirius on the Queen's Chamber, where the story says a Queen's Chamber shaft points at Orion.

plain: The theory is that the two inner rooms of the Great Pyramid at Giza, known as the King's Chamber and the Queen's Chamber, point at different star groups, with the Queen's Chamber facing the star Sirius, in a pattern said to match the sky of 10,500 BC. A researcher named Matt LaCroix tells this on the show without naming a source. If right, it would push the pyramid's planning far back before the date usually given for it.
